about: Batch 5: the output changes made on purpose, compared with 151e40c by `bash scripts/golden-check.sh 151e40c [quick|full] --expect tests/golden_expect/batch5.json --items ...`. Each entry accepts the + or - lines (diff of one item, post against pre) its lines_rx search, in items whose name key_rx searches, in scenarios scenario_rx searches; must_see: the change has to show up wherever its scenarios ran.

entries.why: MASK_VERSION 3 -> 4 (c2, c3, c4): the marker says every approved copy was masked again by version 4
MASK_VERSION 3 -> 4: each approved copy is re-masked and records version 4 (checked character by character on the full run: only the version number differs; no copy's text changed in these boxes)
MASK_VERSION 3 -> 4: engine cache entries are re-masked and record version 4
open_by_severity counts the owner's findings only: the bundled pptx template's WT-T008 platform line (info) leaves it
the new platform_notes {count, lines} and the old platform key holding the same plain lines (was: rule, label, title at path)

entries.why: fit() keeps the audit JSON under 4 KB: the added platform_notes and alias (about 280 bytes a note) push one or two more list items (a tip, a top fix, a coverage note, a stage name, one new item) into `truncated` in these two boxes, which were at the edge on 151e40c; new_total and delta_file stay whole
